label: Analyst formulation, attribution deferred: for any proposed historical and essential relations…
meaning: Analyst formulation, attribution deferred: for any proposed historical and essential relations, well-founded essential dependence excludes a Nat-indexed historical descent if every historical edge is essential. Without that dictionary, a concrete Option Nat model has nonempty well-founded essential dependence (none sustains each some n), while the same some n form an injective infinite historical descent with a historical predecessor for every member and no historical edge essential. Formal relation-level compatibility only, not metaphysical possibility, actual history, a temporal/intervention semantics or permission for all per-accidens series. Existing finite-depth and Second Way omission controls are reused unchanged.
